source_snapshot.procedure: Boot to BIOS, change `all/random` settings in this function to non-default, save/reboot and verify persistence, invoke Load Default, save/reboot and verify the function matches SPEC.
source_snapshot.criteria: No error logs; normal reboot without hang/crash; changed settings persist; defaults match SPEC.
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: DeepSeek correctly identifies the interactive BIOS boundary but does not resolve `all/random`, define values/defaults, account for USB-dependent console/boot/storage, or address the potentially global effect of Load Default.

original_test_intent.purpose: Verify that the intended Advanced USB Configuration fields accept approved non-default values, retain them through save/reboot, and return to the platform SPEC defaults after Load Default without reboot, USB, boot, storage or management failure.
original_test_intent.target: The exact Advanced USB Configuration page and field set on the selected board/BIOS build, plus every non-USB BIOS setting affected by the platform's Load Default action.
original_test_intent.scope: A two-transition persistence/default-restoration test: baseline to approved non-default USB values, then Load Default to documented USB defaults. The source phrase `all/random` does not define whether every field or a sampled subset is mandatory and requires an owner decision before execution.
original_test_intent.operation: Capture the complete deployed BIOS baseline and USB/console/boot/storage topology, apply a signed field/value coverage matrix manually, save/reboot and prove persistence, invoke the exact documented Load Default action, save/reboot, compare all tested USB fields with SPEC, identify all collateral BIOS changes, then restore the deployed recipe if it differs from defaults.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: One non-default persistence cycle and one Load Default cycle, with the required reboot and BIOS re-entry after each. The 20-minute machine and 5-minute attended values are estimates.
original_test_intent.expected_result: Every owner-required field retains the approved non-default value after the first reboot; Load Default restores each tested USB field to the exact SPEC value; reboot completes without hang/crash or unexpected logs; required keyboard, console, boot, storage, USB and management paths remain recoverable; the final deployed configuration is restored if required.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: Board/BIOS identity; signed all-versus-sample coverage decision; complete field/non-default/default matrix; full BIOS baseline/export where supported; critical USB dependency map; visual before/after captures; both reboot timelines; USB/boot/storage/console/BMC evidence; collateral-default diff; SPEC comparison and final deployed-recipe restoration.
ambiguities: `Change all/random setting` is internally ambiguous about coverage and cannot support an objective completeness claim.
The source does not provide field names, legal non-default values or SPEC defaults.
Load Default may be global rather than scoped to the USB page and can change unrelated boot, security, CPU, memory, PCIe or management settings.
The source verifies defaults but does not state whether the SUT must remain at defaults or return to its approved deployed recipe afterward.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly rejects random mutation, adds a bounded field matrix, protects USB-dependent control/boot/storage paths and requires recovery. It does not explicitly preserve the unresolved all-versus-sample coverage decision and treats Load Default mainly as USB-focused without requiring a complete collateral BIOS diff and deployed-recipe restoration decision.

applicable_history.decision: The historical review marks the case manual and interactive but provides no field/default matrix or interpretation of `all/random`.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Keep MANUAL ONLY, but do not silently redefine `all/random`. The BIOS owner must declare full-field or sampled coverage, provide exact values/defaults and define whether global Load Default is authorized and how the deployed recipe is restored.

available_now: The source clearly requires non-default persistence followed by default restoration across two reboots.
Read-only inventory and BIOS baseline evidence can be collected before any setting change.
V2 already identifies USB console/boot/storage dependencies and the need for OOB recovery.
missing_inputs: Engineer decision on all fields versus a documented sampling rule, with the exact required field list
Per-field legal non-default values and authoritative defaults for the exact board/BIOS revision
Documented scope of Load Default, approved collateral-change matrix, deployed-recipe restore decision and full recovery method
Critical USB/keyboard/KVM/boot/storage dependency mapping, maintenance window and manual operator
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The BIOS/vendor owner defines field coverage, values, defaults and Load Default scope; the system owner defines the deployed final recipe and approves reboot/global changes; the lab owner supplies console, alternate input/media, OOB recovery and an operator.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Capture board/BIOS build, every visible Advanced USB field/value, current boot/security/CPU/memory/PCIe/management settings or a supported BIOS export, and preserve logs
Inventory USB controllers/devices, keyboard/KVM, boot/recovery media, USB-attached storage and OOB health; build a dependency and prospective default-diff matrix
prohibited_until_closed: Do not choose fields randomly, infer defaults, disable an unidentified USB control, save/reboot or invoke Load Default before signed coverage/value/global-impact approval
Do not assume Load Default is page-local, rely on the affected USB keyboard as the sole recovery path, clear logs or release the SUT at defaults when the deployed recipe requires restoration
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: A signed run card resolves all-versus-sample coverage, names every field/non-default/default, identifies critical dependencies and global default changes, approves both reboots and Load Default, provides independent OOB recovery, and specifies/proves the final deployed configuration.

revision_candidate.test_name: Advanced USB Configuration Persistence and Default Restoration
revision_candidate.purpose: Verify approved Advanced USB settings persist after save/reboot and return to exact platform defaults after the authorized Load Default action, without losing required USB, console, boot, storage or management functionality.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The exact board and BIOS revision in a maintenance window with a complete BIOS baseline, validated pre-OS console, alternate input/recovery media, BMC/OOB access and a platform-specific USB/default specification.
revision_candidate.target_scope: The engineer-approved complete or sampled Advanced USB field list. Also track every collateral BIOS setting changed by Load Default; do not assume the action is limited to the USB page.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Signed field coverage rule; legal non-default and SPEC-default value for each field; BIOS baseline/export; Load Default scope; critical USB/boot/storage map; deployed final recipe; operator, approval, OOB/alternate recovery, stable power and evidence plan.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Record all target and collateral baselines; manually apply only the signed non-default matrix; save/reboot and prove each target persisted plus system health; manually invoke the approved Load Default; save/reboot and compare targets and collateral settings with SPEC; restore and verify the deployed recipe when it differs from defaults.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Coverage and values resolved; exact firmware/default reference available; current configuration recoverable; critical USB paths and alternative control identified; global default impact approved; boot window, operator, power and OOB recovery ready; logs preserved.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Identity and signed matrix; baseline/export; visual per-field non-default, persisted and default states; both save/reboot records; console/USB/boot/storage/OS/BMC health; complete collateral setting diff; error-log delta; final deployed configuration proof.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The exact platform BIOS specification/default table and owner-approved coverage matrix for this firmware revision, plus the deployed system recipe for final restoration.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Never use random values, mutate unspecified fields, invoke unscoped defaults without approval, rely on one USB control path, clear evidence, omit collateral setting checks or leave the SUT in an unapproved default/deployed state.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: BIOS and system owners approve field coverage, every non-default value, both reboots, global Load Default impact and final recipe. A human operator performs and observes pre-OS changes.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: BIOS navigation, value changes, visual persistence/default judgment and recovery remain manual. An agent may collect read-only inventories, compare signed matrices and verify OS/BMC/device health.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On keyboard/KVM, boot/media/storage, management or reboot failure, stop further changes, preserve console/state evidence, use independent BMC/OOB or approved recovery media, restore the captured configuration or vendor baseline, then verify the complete deployed recipe before retry.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unresolved all-versus-sample scope, missing field/default/global-impact data, no independent console/recovery, unexpected field or collateral change, lost input/boot/storage/management, reboot hang/crash, error log, failed persistence/default comparison or inability to restore the approved final recipe.

identified_defects: The source's `all/random` instruction is not a reproducible coverage definition and permits unsafe arbitrary mutation.
Neither source nor V2 makes the potentially global blast radius of Load Default fully auditable.
The required final state is ambiguous when SPEC defaults differ from the deployed platform recipe.
reason_for_change: Avoid silently reducing an ambiguous all/random source scope and prevent a global Load Default operation from being treated as a USB-page-only change or leaving the system outside its approved deployed recipe.
removed_ambiguities: Makes the all-versus-sample choice an explicit engineer decision rather than an implicit reviewer rewrite.
Separates USB default verification from global collateral settings and final deployed-recipe restoration.
resolved_blockers: The intent and manual capability are understandable; missing field/default data and approvals are provisionable readiness conditions.
remaining_blockers: No BIOS mutation until coverage, values/defaults, Load Default scope, critical dependencies, recovery and final deployed state are owner-approved.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 preserves V2's USB safety controls while exposing the unresolved source coverage instead of silently choosing a subset, and adds full-system default-diff plus final deployed-recipe controls for the global Load Default action.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The isolated validator preserved non-default USB persistence, the global Load Default phase, collateral-function checks and the approved final deployed configuration.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: The source requires non-default Advanced USB settings to persist through one save/reboot and SPEC defaults to reappear after Load Default and a second save/reboot.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 correctly bounds USB changes but does not require an owner decision on all versus sampled fields or audit the full global Load Default diff/final recipe.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: No random settings or global default load without a signed matrix, complete BIOS baseline, independent recovery and proof that the deployed final recipe is restored.
